name: Wilcox Pass
why: A short climb out of the forest to open meadows and bighorn sheep, facing the Athabasca Glacier and the peaks of the Columbia Icefield.
book: No permit. Trailhead at Wilcox Creek campground, 3 km south of the Columbia Icefield Centre on the Icefields Parkway.
dangers: Cold wind off the icefield even in summer.
Snow until late June and from late September.

points.name: Wilcox Creek trailhead
points.note: At the campground entrance on the Icefields Parkway.

points.name: Wilcox Pass
points.note: A wide meadow pass at 2,370 m above the Columbia Icefield.
